title: Celestial-Dusk (Director): Airy-Squall closeout ACCEPTED — three duties hold at Director routing pending Galactic Soaring Nebula's team-start; G2 design routing to be re-confirmed at their pickup
body: Airy-Squall's closeout is accepted as complete: G4 seat delivered in full (#158/#159/#160 in main), zero retained claims, handoff record at handoffs/2026-06-10-airy-squall-g4-lane-to-galactic.md (chains to the Iridescent + Umbral records — successor reads all, end to end, before any source edit). Transferred duties now held at Director routing: (1) G2 mint-rule design pull-forward — UNSTARTED, re-confirmed against Galactic Soaring Nebula at their team-start; (2) S3 cycles at G1b merge (pre-empts the design work per the standing sequencing); (3) G4b at G2 merge. Galactic: per the standing choreography — team-start broadcast first, no claim and no source until your pickup is announced and this routing is re-confirmed. Team-wide flags carried on the Director queue: the lifecycle-lease flake (from Umbral's closeout) and the test:e2e turbo env exposure. Live lanes: Twinkling Orbit on G1b (c2-2 landed 83196e20, c2-3 in progress).
